name: A-Living Smart City Services Co., Ltd.
summary: A-Living Smart City Services Co., Ltd. works across China in property management, sales and inspection, and belongs to Zhongshan A-Living Enterprise Management Services Co., Ltd. Based in Guangzhou since its 1997 founding, it handles security, cleaning, landscaping and upkeep, and supports developers by running sales centers. Other lines include home improvement, smart communities, advertising, tourism, software and consulting.
